fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Primo Brands / former Nestle Waters (BlueTriton) Deer Park bottling plant, 100 Nestle Way, McBee SC. Supplied reference coords (34.4700,-80.2586) landed on the town of McBee ~1.6km NW; web-verified plant address geocode (N34 27 44, W80 14 16 = 34.46226,-80.23788) put me on the cleared industrial parcel SE of town off US-1/US-601. Locked building center at 34.46378,-80.23403 from zoom 17-20 satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: West building face has a long bank of dock positions sheltered under projecting canopies/awnings with diagonal-striped approach lanes; canopies obscure exact door count. Estimated ~28 doors across the loading face. Treat as 25-50 band, low precision.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the highway entrance (Street View 2023-07 shows only an open turn-lane entry and a monument sign, no booth) and none resolvable at the yard entry. Marked false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: There is a controlled single-point truck entrance off a divided highway (dedicated turn lane, monument sign) but no guard shack, implying kiosk / call-box / app check-in at the yard. Set true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance drive off US-1/601 divided highway with a dedicated turn lane; long private drive into property. No barrier arm resolvable in imagery but it is a clear single pinch-point truck entrance. Set true (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the entry drive and the dock face provides ample internal queuing room before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entry drive from the highway runs several hundred meters into the property and the internal yard is deep; easily holds 3+ trucks. True.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved central drive lane through the trailer yard and a single open entry give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop yard on the west/northwest side holds many parked drop trailers in long rows (counted ~70-80 trailers in imagery); 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Distinct paved trailer-storage lot west of the building, separate from the active dock apron, full of parked trailers. True.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated ~110 trailer stalls across the drop-yard rows; ~75 trailers visibly parked in the captured imagery. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main ~200,000 sq ft bottling plant plus one separate long building to the NW (likely office/maintenance/secondary warehouse). Treated as 2 buildings; not a multi-large-cluster campus, so multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; nearest tracks not adjacent. False.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural site in open farmland southeast of a very small town (McBee, pop ~700); cellular coverage likely marginal. Medium confidence, inferred.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad resolvable in the truck path.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~78 acres from the perimeter polygon of the cleared/graded parcel; the fenced operating footprint is smaller. Approximate.
fieldNotes.method: Satellite zoom 16-20 plus highway Street View (2023-07, pano vXBOiv3pfZXVJd-IITpynw). No interior Street View coverage (private rural site); all zone SV metadata except the highway entrance returned ZERO_RESULTS.
